description: Esptein cites Bill Gates' then-wife Melinda as a contributing factor in their declined relationship, which aligns with Melinda's statement that Bill's friendship with Epstein was a factor in their deteriorated marriage. The emails Epstein mentions do not, at least as-of-yet, appear in the Epstein files.
headline: Jeffrey Epstein Drafted Multiple Emails to Bill Gates Concerning their Relationship

info.description: Epstein and Gates' personal relationship was not publicly known at this time.
info.note: This information was revealed in the 2026-01-30 document dump from the Department of Justice pertaining to the Epstein Files Transparency Act.
